intro: Every checkpoint shows what it unlocks and where to go next.
selfAttest: I completed the practice and meet these criteria.
nextEmpty: Choose a pathway first to see your next steps and matched opportunities.
nextNoCheckpoint: Complete a checkpoint to see your next steps.
error: Please try again. Your progress is saved when online.
catalogueIntro: Browse available learning pathways. Demo topics illustrate the learning journey; they are not verified public-beta curricula.
catalogueError: Topics could not be loaded. Try again.
noTopics: No topics on this page. Try another search or return to the previous page.
actionUnconfirmed: The request could not be confirmed. Check your current progress before trying again.
journeyLoadError: Your learning information could not be loaded. Try loading it again.
chooseToBegin: Choose a pathway to get started.
guestJourney: Start as a guest. Your name is optional. You can skip a checkpoint, restart or switch pathways.
restartConfirm: Restart this pathway? This clears its checkpoint and lesson progress. Other pathway checkpoint records are kept.
pathwayFinished: You have reached the end of this pathway. You can revisit lessons, restart or explore another topic.
noLessons: No reading picks are available right now. You can continue your practice and check again later.
checkpointUnavailable: This checkpoint is not available on the current pathway.
noOpportunities: No sample opportunities are available for this step.
noEnrollableTopics: No pathways are available for enrollment right now. Please check again later.
accountOptional: Accounts are optional. You can keep learning as a guest.
accountRecoveryUnavailable: Email verification and password recovery are not available yet. Do not rely on recovery during this unreleased preview.
accountLoadError: Could not load account status. Retry explicitly; reload if an offline shell update is required.
accountActionError: Account action failed. Check your connection before trying again.
accountDeleteConfirm: Permanently delete your account and learning progress?
accountPasswordHelp: New accounts require a password of 12–128 characters. Choose a password you do not use elsewhere.
accountAttach: Attach this guest profile and its progress when creating my account
accountLoginGuest: Signing in restores your account profile and ends this browser's guest session. Guest data is not merged; attach it during registration if you want to keep using it.
